  confidence=4

Related changes are in .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (push_shape_only) and .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (SESSION_FIXABLE_FINDINGS). The new changelog.d/8180-auto-mode-shape-denies.md covers the new behaviour, but the older fragment was not amended, so the folded CHANGELOG.md would contradict itself. Severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR across reviewers; the highest was MAJOR.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/claude_template_drift.py:117-121 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: settings_match_template() does not check that permissions.allow is a list, so null, a number or an object raises TypeError in len() or the slice. A string compares characters instead of rules.
  WHY: The four parity assertions (tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:1117, tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:2451, tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py:261, tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py:242) would crash instead of returning False. The suggested fix is `if not isinstance(live_allow, list): return False`, plus a `{"permissions": {"allow": 5}}` case in tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Auto-mode shape doubts and the allow-rule cases are now denied with rewrite steps, so release notes should not say those commands "still prompt". | Expected change site: changelog.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md, line 4 | Evidence of absence: The sibling fragment still says these cases "still prompt", while .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py (auto_shape_deny, hazard_auto_deny) now denies them. The new changelog.d/8180-auto-mode-shape-denies.md covers the new behaviour, but the older fragment was not amended. This is a documentation inconsistency, not a runtime defect. | severity=NIT | confidence=3

The suggested fix is `if not isinstance(live_allow, list): return False` before the slice, plus a non-list case in tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py:273-274.

The agents.d fragment was updated, but the changelog twin was not. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
